WITH quarters AS (
  SELECT * FROM (VALUES (1),(2),(3),(4)) AS v(q)
),
ledger_filtered AS (
  SELECT
    je.id,
    je.direction,
    je.amount,
    je.currency_code,
    je.occurred_at,
    la.account_type,
    la.name AS account_name
  FROM ledger_entries je
  JOIN ledger_accounts la ON la.id = je.ledger_account_id
  WHERE je.occurred_at >= DATE '2025-01-01'
    AND je.occurred_at < DATE '2026-01-01'
    AND (
      la.account_type IN ('revenue','contra_revenue')
      OR la.name = 'VAT / sales tax payable'
    )
),
ledger_eur AS (
  SELECT
    lf.id,
    lf.direction,
    lf.amount,
    lf.currency_code,
    lf.account_type,
    lf.account_name,
    EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM lf.occurred_at)::int AS q,
    CASE WHEN lf.currency_code = 'EUR' THEN lf.amount
         ELSE lf.amount / er.rate END AS amount_eur
  FROM ledger_filtered lf
  LEFT JOIN exchange_rates er
    ON er.base_code = 'EUR'
   AND er.quote_code = lf.currency_code
   AND er.as_of = lf.occurred_at::date
),
ledger_quarterly AS (
  SELECT
    q,
    SUM(CASE
          WHEN direction = 'credit' AND (account_type = 'revenue' OR account_name = 'VAT / sales tax payable') THEN amount_eur
          WHEN direction = 'debit' AND (account_type = 'contra_revenue' OR account_name = 'VAT / sales tax payable') THEN -amount_eur
          ELSE 0
        END) AS ledger_gross_billed_eur
  FROM ledger_eur
  GROUP BY q
),
payments_filtered AS (
  SELECT
    p.id,
    p.amount,
    p.amount_refunded,
    p.currency_code,
    p.captured_at,
    EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM p.captured_at)::int AS q
  FROM payments p
  WHERE p.captured_at >= DATE '2025-01-01'
    AND p.captured_at < DATE '2026-01-01'
    AND p.status IN ('captured','refunded','partially_refunded')
),
payments_eur AS (
  SELECT
    pf.q,
    CASE WHEN pf.currency_code = 'EUR' THEN (pf.amount - pf.amount_refunded)
         ELSE (pf.amount - pf.amount_refunded) / er.rate END AS net_amount_eur
  FROM payments_filtered pf
  LEFT JOIN exchange_rates er
    ON er.base_code = 'EUR'
   AND er.quote_code = pf.currency_code
   AND er.as_of = pf.captured_at::date
),
payments_quarterly AS (
  SELECT q, SUM(net_amount_eur) AS payments_net_amount_eur
  FROM payments_eur
  GROUP BY q
)
SELECT
  '2025-Q' || quarters.q AS quarter,
  ROUND(COALESCE(lq.ledger_gross_billed_eur,0), 2) AS ledger_gross_billed_eur,
  ROUND(COALESCE(pq.payments_net_amount_eur,0), 2) AS payments_net_amount_eur,
  ROUND(COALESCE(lq.ledger_gross_billed_eur,0) - COALESCE(pq.payments_net_amount_eur,0), 2) AS diff_eur,
  ROUND(
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(pq.payments_net_amount_eur,0) = 0 THEN NULL
         ELSE (COALESCE(lq.ledger_gross_billed_eur,0) - COALESCE(pq.payments_net_amount_eur,0)) / pq.payments_net_amount_eur * 100
    END, 2
  ) AS diff_pct
FROM quarters
LEFT JOIN ledger_quarterly lq ON lq.q = quarters.q
LEFT JOIN payments_quarterly pq ON pq.q = quarters.q
ORDER BY quarters.q
note: Ledger-side EUR conversion uses the exchange rate as of the entry's own occurred_at date (same for payments on captured_at); rows in EUR itself skip the rate join. diff_pct is NULL for a quarter if payments_net_amount_eur is exactly 0, to avoid divide-by-zero.
